messages:
sam: Heads up — proposing a soft-pin of runtime 3.2.1 for quantized Llama3 variants during tomorrow's change window (02:00 UTC). Observed long-seq perf regressions in canary tests.

maria: Which pools are affected? Any customer-facing errors or just perf? :eyes:

sam: Primary signal from g3 and g3-fallback. No customer 5xxs, but token latency and sampling divergence on >1024 sequences. Quality evals show a small but consistent regress.

jordan: Are we also pinning SDK or model variants? Want to avoid client mismatch.

sam: Plan is runtime-only soft-pin (no forced rollback) to force older kernel selection for those pools. SDK stays at 1.9.x. Models unchanged. If metrics look stable after 1h canary we unwind.

maria: OK canary plan? I can watch telemetry and alert on regressions.

sam: Canary: g3-canary (5 nodes), 02:00 UTC. 15m steady-state, then 1h observation. If latency or sampling error > threshold we rollback the soft-pin (manual).

jordan: Outline rollback playbook here pls so oncall can act quickly.

oncall: @oncall We will need the playbook link and a patch to pinlist. Also please notify any active Dedicated customers using g3 pools.

sam: Rollback playbook — quick steps: 1) remove pin in /pinlist/runtime (patch), 2) trigger deploy-bot unpin job, 3) monitor rollback metrics for 30m, 4) notify customers. I pasted the pin snippet below.

sam: ```
{
  "runtime_pins": [
    {"pool": "g3", "runtime": "3.2.1", "mode": "soft"},
    {"pool": "g3-fallback", "runtime": "3.2.1", "mode": "soft"}
  ]
}
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled soft-pin job created: job_id=rb-20241110-01, target_pools=[g3,g3-fallback], runtime=3.2.1, mode=soft. Canary g3-canary will apply at 2024-11-10T02:00:00Z.

maria: I'll own telemetry and quality checks. Will post screenshots if anything drifts.

jordan: I'll update the release notes section and add a line to the SDK compat table clarifying runtime pin only.

oncall: Please add a short pager note in the change window and mark this high priority.

devex: Can we also add a quick note to the console rollout docs so SREs see the pin policy? small doc patch suggested.

sam: Agree. Small doc PR incoming.

maria: If canary stable after 1h, plan: staggered unwind across g3 clusters over next 4h (20% increments) to avoid thundering herd.

jordan: If we see regression during staggered unwind we reapply the soft-pin and escalate. Decision point: if sampling divergence > 0.5% revert.

sam: TL;DR: runtime soft-pin (3.2.1) for quantized Llama3 on g3 pools, canary 02:00 UTC, 1h observation, staggered unwind if stable. Rollback playbook ready. Tagging: @oncall @devex @maria @jordan :shipit:

maria: :thumbsup: I'll be on watch.

jordan: PR to release-notes in progress.

deploy-bot: Job rb-20241110-01 applied to g3-canary at 2024-11-10T02:00:12Z — canary started.

sam: Thanks everyone. Will post final status after observation window.
